text: 据央视，欧洲中央银行行长拉加德近日接受专访。在谈及全球经济前景与形势时，拉加德表示，全球经济在面对诸如俄乌冲突、能源危机等冲击时展现出了远超预期的韧性，但负面影响也同时存在，地缘政治局势的演变以及人们的行动正在阻碍本可实现的经济发展。
text_en: According to CCTV, ECB President Christine Lagarde recently gave an exclusive interview. Discussing the global economic outlook and situation, Lagarde said the global economy has shown resilience far exceeding expectations in the face of shocks such as the Russia-Ukraine conflict and the energy crisis, but negative effects also persist, with the evolution of the geopolitical situation and people's actions hampering economic development that could otherwise be achieved.
